posts.title: Stop Making TUIs
posts.description: Our field has a weird relationship with terminal and command line interfaces. The time has come to re-evaluate it. I’m on a kick lately getting my friends to try building native user interfaces. I built my first serious Mac application a few months ago, and since then I’ve built more native UI thingies than in my entire career prior to that. Let’s take a quick tour.
